# Command reference

Inspect Check Point Email Security through compact, guarded AXI commands.
Email, event, task and exception reads use the regional API; doctor checks authentication and one bounded search, while discovery commands stay local.
Run each command with `--help` for concise help.

## auth status

Validate the selected local profile and secret source without API calls

| Flag | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--config` | Config path; default CHECKPOINT_AXI_CONFIG or platform path |
| `--profile` | Profile name; default CHECKPOINT_AXI_PROFILE, env profile, config default, or sole profile |
| `--fields` | Comma-separated output fields; default all |
| `--full` | Show full strings instead of 500-character previews; default false |
| `--help` | Show concise command help; default false |

```sh
checkpoint-axi auth status
checkpoint-axi auth status --profile example
```

## config path

Show config and state paths without reading files; --profile does not affect paths

| Flag | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--config` | Config path; default CHECKPOINT_AXI_CONFIG or platform path |
| `--profile` | Profile name; default CHECKPOINT_AXI_PROFILE, env profile, config default, or sole profile |
| `--fields` | Comma-separated output fields; default all |

| `--help` | Show concise command help; default false |

```sh

checkpoint-axi config path --fields config
```

## doctor

Check regional API authentication and one bounded email search without printing tenant data

| Flag | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--config` | Config path; default CHECKPOINT_AXI_CONFIG or platform path |
| `--profile` | Profile name; default CHECKPOINT_AXI_PROFILE, env profile, config default, or sole profile |
| `--fields` | Comma-separated output fields; default all |
| `--full` | Show full strings instead of 500-character previews; default false |
| `--help` | Show concise command help; default false |
| `--saas` | SaaS override; default selected profile saas or office365_emails |

```sh
checkpoint-axi doctor
checkpoint-axi doctor --profile example --saas office365_emails
```

## email quarantine

Preview or request asynchronous email quarantine through the gated write coordinator (guide pages 28-30)

| Flag | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--config` | Config path; default CHECKPOINT_AXI_CONFIG or platform path |
| `--profile` | Profile name; default CHECKPOINT_AXI_PROFILE, env profile, config default, or sole profile |
| `--fields` | Comma-separated output fields; default all |
| `--full` | Show full strings instead of 500-character previews; default false |
| `--help` | Show concise command help; default false |
| `--ids` | Required comma-separated unique entity IDs; maximum 20 |
| `--execute` | Send once after all write gates; default false (preview) |
| `--dry-run` | Explicit preview; cannot combine with --execute |
| `--confirm` | Exact operation followed by a space and the comma-separated IDs in supplied order |

```sh
checkpoint-axi email quarantine --ids <id>
checkpoint-axi email quarantine --ids <id> --execute --confirm 'email.quarantine <id>'
```

## email search

Search emails with a bounded date window and scroll continuation (API guide pages 18-27)

| Flag | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--config` | Config path; default CHECKPOINT_AXI_CONFIG or platform path |
| `--profile` | Profile name; default CHECKPOINT_AXI_PROFILE, env profile, config default, or sole profile |
| `--fields` | Comma-separated output fields; default all |
| `--full` | Show full strings instead of 500-character previews; default false |
| `--help` | Show concise command help; default false |
| `--saas` | SaaS override; default selected profile saas or office365_emails |
| `--saas-entity` | Optional SaaS entity type selector |
| `--start-date` | ISO timestamp with timezone; default 24 hours before end-date; maximum window 31 days |
| `--end-date` | ISO timestamp with timezone; default now |
| `--limit` | Maximum rows; default 50, range 1-1000; cannot combine with --all |
| `--all` | Read up to 1000 rows / 10 HTTP requests / 60 seconds / 8 MiB; default false |
| `--cursor` | Opaque continuation bound to profile, region, operation and selectors; repeat original selectors |
| `--filter` | JSON array of {saasAttrName, saasAttrOp, saasAttrValue} filters (guide pages 19-20) |

```sh
checkpoint-axi email search
checkpoint-axi email search --all --saas office365_emails
checkpoint-axi email search --cursor <cursor>
```

## event list

List security events with bounded scroll continuation (API guide pages 37-42)

| Flag | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--config` | Config path; default CHECKPOINT_AXI_CONFIG or platform path |
| `--profile` | Profile name; default CHECKPOINT_AXI_PROFILE, env profile, config default, or sole profile |
| `--fields` | Comma-separated output fields; default all |

| `--help` | Show concise command help; default false |
| `--start-date` | ISO timestamp with timezone; default 24 hours before end-date; maximum window 31 days |
| `--end-date` | ISO timestamp with timezone; default now |
| `--limit` | Maximum rows; default 50, range 1-1000; cannot combine with --all |
| `--all` | Read up to 1000 rows / 10 HTTP requests / 60 seconds / 8 MiB; default false |
| `--cursor` | Opaque continuation bound to profile, region, operation and selectors; repeat original selectors |
| `--saas` | Comma-separated SaaS overrides; default selected profile saas or office365_emails |
| `--event-types` | Comma-separated event types; default unfiltered |
| `--event-states` | Comma-separated event states; default unfiltered |
| `--severities` | Comma-separated severities; default unfiltered |
| `--event-ids` | Comma-separated event IDs; default unfiltered |
| `--confidence-indicator` | Confidence indicator selector; default unfiltered |
| `--description` | Description selector; default unfiltered |

```sh
checkpoint-axi event list
checkpoint-axi event list --all --event-types phishing
checkpoint-axi event list --cursor <cursor>
```

## exception list

List bounded exceptions for phishing-allow, phishing-block, spam-allow, anomaly, click-time, malware, url or dlp (guide pages 49-123)

| Flag | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--config` | Config path; default CHECKPOINT_AXI_CONFIG or platform path |
| `--profile` | Profile name; default CHECKPOINT_AXI_PROFILE, env profile, config default, or sole profile |
| `--fields` | Comma-separated output fields; default all |
| `--full` | Show full strings instead of 500-character previews; default false |
| `--help` | Show concise command help; default false |
| `--type` | Required for malware: hash,micro_hash,file_type,ppat_sender_name,allow_file_type,sender_email; url: allow-url,allow-domain,block-url,block-domain; dlp: hash,text_content,sender_email,recipient_email |
| `--items` | Click-time item routes instead of list routes; default false |
| `--limit` | Maximum rows; default 50, range 1-1000; cannot combine with --all |
| `--all` | Return up to 1000 rows within transport budgets; no server continuation parameter is documented |

```sh
checkpoint-axi exception list phishing-allow
checkpoint-axi exception list malware --type hash
checkpoint-axi exception list click-time --items --all
```

## exception show

| Flag | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--config` | Config path; default CHECKPOINT_AXI_CONFIG or platform path |
| `--profile` | Profile name; default CHECKPOINT_AXI_PROFILE, env profile, config default, or sole profile |

| `--help` | Show concise command help; default false |
| `--type` | Required for malware: hash,micro_hash,file_type,ppat_sender_name,allow_file_type,sender_email; url: allow-url,allow-domain,block-url,block-domain; dlp: hash,text_content,sender_email,recipient_email |
| `--items` | Click-time item route instead of list route; default false |

```sh
checkpoint-axi exception show phishing-block <id>

```
